published_title: Big Blue done RIGHT aka Retardosaurus Rex ISB
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''HuntaWarya''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: The ISB space deck that revolutionalized dark side deck design, and took 1st place at the Vegas DPC.

notes: The published title contains a slur ('Retardosaurus'), so this page is titled Brian Hunter DS; the post's title is kept in the source citation as published.

The description says the deck took 1st place at the Vegas DPC; recorded as 1st at the 2001 Vegas DPC on the poster's word. The strategy says the posted list differs from the one played (combo Ghhhk and Captain Godherdt in Vegas instead of Ghhhk and Masterful Move).

No separate starting section is posted; the strategy starts the Objective with Prepared Defenses pulling Mobilization Points and Imperial Arrest Order plus a third Effect that varies (You Cannot Hide Forever, Imperial Decree, Something Special Planned For Them or There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement). All are in the listed 60.
Posted 'ISB Operations/Watch Your Step is Dead' dested ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents (the flip side's name is a joke about Watch Your Step).

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Kessel', 'Sullust' and 'Endor' the Dark systems; 'Endor Landing Platform' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'Tempest I' Tempest 1; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor.
Secret Plans and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement are Effects in this era.
player_note: Brian Hunter says this is not card-for-card the list he played to win the 2001 Vegas DPC: in Vegas he used the combo Ghhhk (to cancel Landing Claw) and Captain Godherdt in place of Masterful Move.
